unit.why: An exegesis of 'מה רב טובך אשר צפנת ליראיך' followed by a general testimony that the radiance of the master's face during worship was visible to all; no specific event is narrated.
unit.boundary_note: Numbered section (ל) of a series of teachings and recollections about the master; the previous section ends a teaching and the next (לא) begins a biographical narrative.
